policy.purpose: Synthetic engineering test only; not an empirical or nationally representative forecast
policy.within_bin_sampling: Continuous uniform over declared feasible ranges; a development assumption, not a fitted distribution
policy.weekly_rate_meaning: Expected sessions per week; future Poisson counts may lie outside the usual-frequency category
policy.frequency_reconciliation: Intersect total weekly bounds with summed context bounds. For each sampled total, allocate rates between context bounds in proportion to their available widths
policy.context_open_upper: Bound a context's weekly rate by the owner's finite total upper bound; otherwise defer the owner
policy.start_sampling: Uniform inside the reported charging-start window; no additional TOU shift
policy.energy_sampling: Use the owner's usual energy range as shared session evidence across active contexts; it is not context-specific energy evidence
policy.home_power: Use bounded reported home-power ranges; unresolved ranges are deferred
policy.electrical_boundary: For the test only, treat reported delivered energy as charging-load energy; conversion losses and auxiliary loads are not modelled
policy.missing_policy: No imputation of unknown energy, open total-frequency bins, unknown or mixed active charger types
deferred_effects: Urgent-trip event rates and energy adjustments
Queues, station failures and location-switch probabilities
policy.nonhome_power: Use each context's power_model; no legacy fixed DC fallback.
policy.power_boundary: Effective power and energy at the same delivered-energy boundary. No grid-side conversion loss or auxiliary-load estimate is added.

summary.warning: The selected pool is a biased completeness subset. Do not extrapolate its composition to Sri Lankan EV owners.

behaviour_constraints.name: Keep multiple contexts within one owner
behaviour_constraints.quote: If I have errands after work, I sometimes use a charger near the office.
behaviour_constraints.implementation: Sample an owner profile with all its context records. Allocate each session to one context; do not treat each context row as a different owner.
behaviour_constraints.boundary: Interview context mentions are not allocation weights. Survey total and context frequencies still need reconciliation.
behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
behaviour_constraints.full_answer: On workdays I usually come home and connect the car. I check what I need to do the next morning, then decide whether to schedule the charging for later. If I have errands after work, I sometimes use a charger near the office.

behaviour_constraints.name: Use the reported charging-start window once
behaviour_constraints.quote: I connect it when I get home, but I set the car to begin charging later.
behaviour_constraints.implementation: Use survey charging-start windows as actual start windows. Do not apply an additional automatic TOU delay to the baseline profile.
behaviour_constraints.boundary: A future tariff-change scenario would require separately stated assumptions; usual reported timing does not measure its causal effect.
behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
behaviour_constraints.full_answer: I connect it when I get home, but I set the car to begin charging later. If I must leave early the next morning, I sometimes start immediately because I would rather pay more than risk having too little charge.

behaviour_constraints.name: Separate active charging from connected time
behaviour_constraints.quote: At home the car can remain connected after it finishes, but it stops drawing power at the target.
behaviour_constraints.implementation: Accumulate demand only over active charging intervals. Keep parked or connected duration separate from electrical charging duration.
behaviour_constraints.boundary: A recalled duration is not automatically a measured active duration. Any simplified power curve must be declared separately.
behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
behaviour_constraints.full_answer: At home the car can remain connected after it finishes, but it stops drawing power at the target. At a public station I watch the app and return around completion because someone else may need the charger.

behaviour_constraints.name: Respect reported home-charging access
behaviour_constraints.quote: I cannot charge at home. I park in a shared apartment area and there is no approved charging point there.
behaviour_constraints.implementation: If survey home access is 'No, I cannot charge at home', do not create T2 sessions. Flag contradictory home-use answers for review instead of silently rewriting them.
behaviour_constraints.boundary: Limited access is not the same as no access. The interview case cannot be linked to a survey owner by its number.
behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
behaviour_constraints.full_answer: I cannot charge at home. I park in a shared apartment area and there is no approved charging point there.

behaviour_constraints.name: Keep energy accounting consistent across sessions
behaviour_constraints.quote: I charged less at home the following night.
behaviour_constraints.implementation: Account for energy across an owner's sessions. A context switch must not automatically add a second full daily energy requirement; extra travel can increase energy only through an explicit assumption or observation.
behaviour_constraints.boundary: The passage supports possible substitution, not a fixed amount or universal replacement rule. Do not add distance-derived energy to delivered energy for the same requirement.
behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
behaviour_constraints.full_answer: Last month a relative needed a lift that evening. I used a public charger near the hospital because the planned overnight home charge would have been too late. I charged less at home the following night.

behaviour_constraints.name: Keep temporary disruption separate from usual behaviour
behaviour_constraints.quote: A temporary equipment problem can make a normally home-dominant owner appear public-dominant in a short observation window.
behaviour_constraints.implementation: Retain an exceptional-period annotation when reviewing evidence. Do not overwrite usual survey behaviour solely because a short public-charging history differs.
behaviour_constraints.boundary: Do not infer an equipment failure from a mismatch alone, or automatically discard records. An exceptional-period flag requires supporting evidence.
behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
behaviour_constraints.full_answer: A temporary equipment problem can make a normally home-dominant owner appear public-dominant in a short observation window.

behaviour_constraints.name: Trip urgency may change charging decisions
behaviour_constraints.quote: If I do not know whether there will be an extra trip tomorrow, I charge earlier and aim a little higher.
behaviour_constraints.implementation: Keep this as a contextual dependency. Do not introduce random urgent-trip events or a fixed target increase in the baseline yet.
behaviour_constraints.boundary: An event rate and adjustment magnitude need observations or explicitly labelled sensitivity assumptions; 'a little higher' provides neither.
behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
behaviour_constraints.full_answer: If I do not know whether there will be an extra trip tomorrow, I charge earlier and aim a little higher. That is different from a normal office night when I know the distance.

behaviour_constraints.name: Unavailable chargers may change the next action
behaviour_constraints.quote: If I can get home comfortably, I leave; otherwise I check a second station or wait a short time.
behaviour_constraints.implementation: Retain the conditional options for later analysis. Do not invent queue durations, station failures, or switch probabilities in the baseline.
behaviour_constraints.boundary: Executing a queue or station-availability model would require further evidence or an explicitly separate sensitivity scenario.
behaviour_constraints.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
behaviour_constraints.full_answer: First I look at the battery and the time. If I can get home comfortably, I leave; otherwise I check a second station or wait a short time. I do not assume the next station is free.

config_snapshot.purpose: Synthetic engineering test only; no verified station inventory or national usage mixture.
config_snapshot.fraction_meaning: Average delivered session power divided by rated output; not conversion efficiency.
config_snapshot.weight_meaning: Equal test weights within each context and charger type; not observed usage probabilities.
config_snapshot.scope: Non-home equipment options; T1 may include private workplace charging. Public access and connector compatibility are unresolved.

reduced_test.description: Reduced average output for testing; not measured charging powers.

rated_ceiling_test.description: Rated output throughout a session: a sensitivity setting, not an observed profile or a guaranteed upper bound on aggregate hourly peaks.

limitations: Ratings, weights and power fractions are test assumptions; no national mix was estimated.
Vehicle-specific acceptance limits and connectors are unresolved unless supplied separately.
No site port counts, power sharing, station allocation, queues or charging curves are simulated.
T1 may include private workplace charging; no claim of public station access is made.
This change does not release any deferred owner or complete battery-state modelling.
